---------- Purchase Return ---------- Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Debit), 'Debit' as CrDr From ( Select distinct AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1 {2} INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null {1} {0} {5}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName

inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1

Inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = 1 AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID where AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And IsNull(AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType, 'Credit') = 'Credit' AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} {0} {5} ) as TAB_Inv group by TAB_Inv.CustomerID, TAB_Inv.EmployeeCode, TAB_Inv.Customername, TAB_Inv.BusinessPartnerName
union all
---------- Purchase Return ---------- Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Debit), 'Debit' as CrDr From ( Select distinct AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, '' as PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10),INV_StockTransactionheader.DocumentNo) from INV_StockTransactionDetail inner join INV_StockTransactionheader on INV_StockTransactionheader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1 {2} INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null {1} {0} {5}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName
-----------End Purchase return
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return Select distinct FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Credit), 'Credit' as CrDr From ( SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO , AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} {0}
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.EmployeeCode,FinTab.CustomerName
union all
Select distinct importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(importtab.Amount), 'Credit' as CrDr from ( ---------Import Document --------------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POheaderID as SourceID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'International Vendor'
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%import%' {0} {1}
) as importtab group by importtab.CustomerID, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName
) tab
group by tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.CrDr, tab.BusinessPartnerName
)outerTab
group by OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.CustomerName, outertab.Type,outerTab.BusinessPartnerName
) as LastTab inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = LastTab.BusinessPartnerName inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = LastTab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = LastTab.CompanyID
group by LastTab.CustomerID,LastTab.EmployeeCode,LastTab.CustomerName, LastTab.companyID --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID @WithGroup @ConsolidatedGroup )as fintab

select * ,isnull((select top 1 CustomerCategory from Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = fintab.CustomerID ),'NIll') as CustomerCategory from ( select distinct LastTab.DepartmentName, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerID, LastTab.CustomerName, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) as ActivityCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) as ActivityDebit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) as OpeningCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) as OpeningDebit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) ClosingCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) ClosingDebit, ISNULL(case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull (LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) < 0 then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)), 1)) when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) > 0 then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit,0)), 1)) end ,0) as ClosingAmount, case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) < 0 then 'Credit' when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) > 0 then 'Debit' end as ClosingAmountType --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as BusinessPartnerTypeCode
,(Select Description from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID ) as CodeDescription
@WithConsolidated @WithType from ( select outerTab.DepartmentName, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.CustomerName, OuterTab.BusinessPartnerName, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as ActivityCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as ActivityDebit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as OpeningCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as OpeningDebit from ( select tab.DepartmentName, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerID, tab.CustomerName, tab.BusinessPartnerName, case when tab.CrDr = 'Credit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end CreditAmount, case when tab.CrDr = 'Debit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end DebitAmount, 'Opening' as Type from ( select SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left join HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {0} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all ---------- DI-Customer ---------- select distinct SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID and = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {0} {1} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all

inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null {1} {0} {5}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DepartmentName, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName,FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.CustomerName
-----------End Purchase return
UNION ALL
----Sales Invoice Return Select distinct FinTab.DepartmentName, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.Customername, FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(FinTab.Credit), 'Credit' as CrDr From ( SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO , AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 Left join HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.status =1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1 {1} {0}
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.BusinessPartnerName, FinTab.DepartmentName, FinTab.EmployeeCode, FinTab.CustomerID,FinTab.CustomerName
union all
Select distinct importtab.DepartmentName, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.CustomerID, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName, Sum(importtab.Amount), 'Credit' as CrDr from ( ---------Import Document --------------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CreateDate, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName , AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POheaderID as SourceID, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TotalAmount as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PurchaseOrderHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader .PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.TypeCode and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left join HRMS_SET_Employee on HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID and HRMS_SET_Employee.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and HRMS_SET_Employee.Status = 1 left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = HRMS_SET_Employee.FK_DepartmentID and SET_Department.status =1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'International Vendor'
WHERE AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%import%' {0}
) as importtab group by importtab.DepartmentName, importtab.EmployeeCode, importtab.CustomerID, importtab.Customername, importtab.BusinessPartnerName
) tab
group by tab.DepartmentName, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerID, tab.CustomerName, tab.CrDr, tab.BusinessPartnerName
) outerTab
group by outerTab.DepartmentName, outerTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.CustomerName, outertab.Type,outerTab.BusinessPartnerName
) as LastTab inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = LastTab.BusinessPartnerName inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = LastTab.CustomerID
group by LastTab.DepartmentName, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerID,LastTab.CustomerName --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID @WithGroup @ConsolidatedGroup )as fintab
Order by fintab.BusinessPartnerTypeCode asc

data.name: Query_BusinesspartnerTrialBalanceMonthWise

With mycte as ( select * ,isnull((select top 1 CustomerCategory from Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID = Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = fintab.CustomerID ),'NIll') as CustomerCategory ,case when ClosingAmount < 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingCredit ,case when ClosingAmount > 0 then ClosingAmount else 0 end as ClosingDebit from ( select distinct LastTab.CompanyID, LastTab.CustomerID, LastTab.EmployeeCode, LastTab.CustomerName --, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)) as ActivityCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) as ActivityDebit, -- sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) as OpeningCredit, sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) as OpeningDebit, -- (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))* -1 ClosingCredit, -- sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)) ClosingDebit, -- ISNULL(case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull (LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - -- (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) < 0 -- then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)), 1)) -- when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0))) > 0 -- then abs(round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0)), 1) - round(sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0)) + -- sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit,0)), 1)) end ,0) as ClosingAmounts, ,case when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) < 0 then 'Credit' when (sum(isnull(LastTab.OpeningDebit, 0)) + sum(isnull(LastTab.ActivityDebit, 0))) - (sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.OpeningCredit, 0))) + sum(Abs(isnull(LastTab.ActivityCredit, 0)))) > 0 then 'Debit' end as ClosingAmountType --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as BusinessPartnerTypeCode @WithConsolidated @WithType
,(Select Description from GL_CodeCombinationDetail where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID ) as CodeDescription , 'NOTChecked' as OrderBy ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years,Type,CrDr , case when Type = 'Activity' then SUM(ISNULL(ActivityDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(ActivityCredit,0)) when Type = 'Opening' then SUM(ISNULL(OpeningDebit,0)) - SUM(ISNULL(OpeningCredit,0))
end as ClosingAmount from ( select (Select companyID from AR_SET_Customer as tbl_Customer where tbl_Customer.Status = 1 and tbl_Customer.CustomerID = OuterTab.CustomerID) as CompanyID , OuterTab.CustomerID, OuterTab.CustomerName, OuterTab.EmployeeCode, OuterTab.BusinessPartnerName, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as ActivityCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Activity' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as ActivityDebit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.CreditAmount, 0)) end as OpeningCredit, case when outertab.Type = 'Opening' then SUM(isnull(outerTab.DebitAmount, 0)) end as OpeningDebit ,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years ,outertab.Type,CrDr from ( select tab.CustomerID, tab.EmployeeCode, tab.CustomerName, tab.BusinessPartnerName, case when tab.CrDr = 'Credit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end CreditAmount, case when tab.CrDr = 'Debit' then sum(isnull(tab.Amount, 0)) end DebitAmount, 'Opening' as Type , 'Opening' as MonthNames, '1' MonthNum, '1' as Years,null as crdr from ( select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {0} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all ---------- DI-Customer ---------- select distinct AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID inner join sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 {0} {1} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.Customerid, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Credit' as CrDr from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like 'Customer'
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName

select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} {4} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
union all

select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum(isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount,0)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.periodID = AP_PaymentHeader.periodID {2}
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Vendor Invoice%' Or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against %') {1} {0} {6}
and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID

AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_InvoiceHeader.Invoicedate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.Invoicedate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_InvoiceHeader.Invoicedate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_InvoiceHeader.Invoicedate)),3,4) as Years FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in (SELECT distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID))) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit')
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and isnull(GL_TransactionDetail .Narration,'') not like '%GST%' and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName not like '%GST%' {0} {1} {5} )as tab
union all
select
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum ( AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount ) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID
where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Debit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
union all -- DI-Customer select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,4) as Years
from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed is null {0} {1} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate union all
-- DI-Customer select distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, SUM(sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) as Amount, 'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,4) as Years
from SAL_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
inner join sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.statusCode = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed is not null {0} {1} {3} and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.Customername, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate union all
select
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,sum ( AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount ) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
inner join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12 and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like 'Customer' and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status =1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 {1} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {4} {0} and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType like 'Credit' and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
group by
AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,case when (select DocumentType from Set_documentTYpe where Set_documentTYpe.Status= 1 And Set_documentTYpe.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_documentTYpe.Companyid = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Companyid) like 'Receipt Against Sale%' then ( (select sum(Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.Status = 1) ) else SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount)
end as Amount --,SUM(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount) as Amount ,'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from dbo.AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID {1} --and not exists ( -- select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC -- where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0} {4} and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.statusCode = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Companyid ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
union all ------------ Payment (Debit) (Payment Vendor Invoice) ---------- select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum(isnull(AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, 0)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AP_PaymentHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.periodID = AP_PaymentHeader.periodID {2} inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @todate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and (SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Vendor Invoice%' Or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Payment Against %') {1} {0} {6} and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate
union All ---------- Payment (Debit) ---------- select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) else 0 end) as Amount, 'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.paymentId = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1 {1} {0} {6} and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate
-- payment Adavnce Against PO (Debit)
union all SELECT AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName, sum((Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end)) - isnull(( select sum(Amount) from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail where AP_PaymentSupplierDetail .PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and isnull(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration,'') = 'GST' ),0) as Amount ,'Debit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID and (AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID or AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is null)
inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' {2}
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.statusCode = 1 and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%invoice%' {1} {0} {6} --and AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ='ALI ENTERPRISES'
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID,AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID,AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate -- Payment (Credit)
union All
select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName
,(Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Credit' then SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) * 1 end) as Amount --,SUM(AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount) ,'Credit' as CrDr , DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + ' - ' + substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4)as MonthNames ,MONTH( DATENAME(MONTH,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate) + '1,1') MonthNum, substring(convert(varchar,year(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate)),3,4) as Years from AP_PaymentSupplierDetail
inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID and AR_SET_Customer.Status =1
inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.paymentId = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2}
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode <> 12 inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode where AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.status = 1
{1} {6} --and not exists ( --select * from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes AC --where AC.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- and TypeCode in( 7,12)) {0}
and AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID,AR_SET_Customer.EmployeeCode,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType ,AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate

) as LastTab inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = LastTab.BusinessPartnerName inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = LastTab.CustomerID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = LastTab.CompanyID
group by LastTab.CustomerID,LastTab.EmployeeCode,LastTab.CustomerName, LastTab.companyID,MonthNames,MonthNum,Years,Type,CrDr --,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID @WithGroup @ConsolidatedGroup )as fintab )
